changes: Stage accepts at most 32 explicitly selected regular files with current file revisions or explicit confirmed absence for deletion. Unstage selects exact paths. Both require HEAD, HEAD-file and complete index versions.

A private index consumes raw hash-object/update-index data without repository filters, hooks, signing, network or recursive stage-all. Collateral index changes outside the explicit selection are rejected.

Publication holds index.lock and a prepared Git verify-HEAD transaction. The locked interval starts no child process; descriptor checks, no-replace capture and publication preserve concurrently replaced indexes instead of overwriting them.

Dedicated fixed native-HOME/git-index-state retains before.full, captured before.raw and next slots. Restore requires source hash and current HEAD/index versions; completed-only discard requires a current manifest and confirmation. Native-owned records never authorize another path or positive acceptance.

Full before-images remain self-contained after split-index shared files disappear. Retention limits are 32 projects, 64 payload records and 128 MiB per project, with 16 MiB individual indexes. Unknown materials are never automatically removed.

Author security review found that a registered project .git file could point at a foreign primary repository while rev-parse still reported the selected worktree. Repository metadata now requires either the actual in-root .git directory or bidirectionally linked common/worktrees Git metadata; separate-git-dir without that link is rejected.

validationChain.finding: Selected-root show-toplevel does not prove Git metadata belongs to that root; a foreign primary .git path had no linked-worktree backlink.

coverage: Raw bytes and executable-mode versions; staged/unstaged preservation; delete confirmation; links/special paths; stale HEAD/index/file revisions; real prepared Git locks; SHA-1/SHA-256 unborn branches; publication collision; split-index recovery; completed-only discard and bounded retention; idempotent receipt replay; foreign primary metadata denial; legitimate linked-worktree stage and commit without changing origin HEAD/index.
limits: This is author feature verification, not an independent clean full-repository audit; source remains unfrozen.
Cross-UID RuntimeService/launcher/helper/actual-CLI acceptance remains a separate integration gate; helper tests do not prove gateway registration or browser workflow.
Gateway/witness/receipt/ledger integration has separate root-owned tests (40 passed, run-l5liIZ).
Git locks coordinate ordinary Git writers, not adversarial concurrent filesystem mutation by the same native UID.
Corrupt current indexes or unknown/failed retained records can require operator inspection. No automatic garbage collection, unknown replay, recursive cleanup or foreign lock deletion.
No full suite, paid inference, external MCP, real AWS, remote Git traffic or online service modification.
